summary: Backend is UP and reachable. Root cause of Cloudflare 'invalid response from origin' was cascading HTTP 502 from POST /api/notifications/test-sms when Twilio trial rejects unverified numbers. Fix (return HTTP 200 with success=false) is now in place and verified: 16/16 pytest tests pass, and the SMS-test button in Settings triggers a clean 200 with a red error toast (no 502, no white screen). All requested endpoints respond with status<=500. Cron reminders idempotency (X-Webhook-Id) works. Dashboard sms-stats cards render. Profile PUT /api/auth/me works.

minor.issue: French error mapping in server.py:934 uses case-sensitive checks ('Trial' with capital T, '572006', '21608') but the actual Twilio error we saw is 'HTTP 422 ... No Twilio trial phone number is assigned for messaging to this destination number. Please add the 'to' number as a verified recipient.' (lowercase 'trial', no error code in string). So the raw English Twilio message is passed through instead of the friendly French one. Response is still HTTP 200 with clear content, so no user-visible regression, but the localization intent is defeated. Suggest adding lowercased check: if 'trial' in error.lower() or 'verified recipient' in error.lower().

action_items: (Optional/minor) Improve French error mapping in server.py /notifications/test-sms — match lowercase 'trial' and 'verified recipient' phrases so users see the French message instead of the raw Twilio English string. Current UX is still acceptable.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L934: case-sensitive substring matching on Twilio error is fragile. Prefer normalising to lower(): if any(k in err.lower() for k in ('572006','21608','trial','unverified','verified recipient','predefined sms templates')).
server.py test-sms endpoint correctly returns 200 with success flag even on Twilio failure — good pattern; this eliminated the 502 loop that made Cloudflare mark the origin unhealthy.
Cron /api/cron/reminders idempotency via X-Webhook-Id is properly implemented and returns duplicate=true on repeat.

rca of the issue: User-reported symptom: Cloudflare 'invalid or incomplete response from origin'. Root cause: on each click of 'Envoyer un SMS test', the previous implementation raised an HTTPException(502) because the Twilio trial account throws twilio.base.exceptions.TwilioRestException for unverified destinations. Repeated 502s from the same route made Cloudflare's edge treat the origin as unhealthy and serve its own 'invalid response from origin' error page for subsequent requests. Fix (already applied in server.py 915-948): wrap Twilio call in try/except and always return HTTP 200 with {success:false, channel, to, status, error:<message>} — the endpoint never raises 5xx anymore. Verified end-to-end: curl returns 200; UI shows a red error toast with the readable message and no console/network 5xx.
